result.judge_notes: pass 1 (A=without, B=with): B's mark is one clear idea: a bore shaft cut down through solid ground into a water drop. The page shows it reversed, in one flat color and at several icon sizes, and it still reads at small sizes. A is a busy badge illustration with an oil-style derrick, a sun, hills, a creek and a drop; its small lockups shrink the detail to near-illegibility and add no single-color test. B's typography is a fairly plain system sans set in caps with rules, but its palette and focus suit the business better. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): A has one clear idea: a bore shaft cut into a solid block that ends in water. It shows that mark at several icon sizes, in one color and reversed on a dark background, using only brown and blue. B's badge suits a rural business but is a busy illustration with about seven colors, and its derrick reads more like an oil rig. B's small lockups are so tiny they're hard to read, and it never shows the mark in one color.
